fields.label: Images
fields.instructions: Up to three, placed around the title: top left, bottom left, right.

fields.label: Rating
fields.instructions: The average of the visitors' ratings; set by hand until they can rate.

fields.label: Chapters
fields.instructions: A chapter has its ingredients and its steps: every paragraph is a step, an image belongs to the step above it.

fields.label: Singular
fields.instructions: One of them: *Main Course by …* on the cards.

fields.label: Copyright
fields.instructions: After the ©, e.g. Chuchi Recipes, 2024.

fields.label: Title
fields.instructions: Empty in the first chapter: Ingredients and Instructions.

fields.label: Marquee
fields.instructions: Runs through behind the recipes, e.g. *trending recipes*.

fields.label: Slider
fields.instructions: Scrolls sideways with arrows, else one row.

fields.label: Doodles
fields.instructions: The hand drawn corrections over the title (made for *There's too much sugar in this cake.*).
